plotEn: Twins Bax and April live together and record their dreams onto discs. Both conceal how they earn money: Bax traffics human organs, while April, currently selling wigs made of her hair, considers selling recordings of her dreams to gangster Sergei Tetris. After Bax falls into debt, April disappears. As he works off his debt, Bax searches the city for any trace of her, becoming increasingly consumed by the effort to find her.
